description: This file contains an Android ListActivity implementation that displays a list with separator lines, using a custom adapter (MyListAdapter). It includes methods for list item enabling/disabling based on string content, and inflates TextViews for list items.

classes.name: List5
classes.description: Main activity class extending ListActivity, shows a list with separators.

classes.name: MyListAdapter
classes.description: Inner class extending BaseAdapter, provides custom list item views and enables/disables items based on string content.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method initializing the activity and setting the list adapter.

methods.name: MyListAdapter(Context)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with the provided context.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the list.

methods.name: areAllItemsEnabled
methods.description: Overrides to indicate not all items are enabled.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Determines if a list item at given position is enabled based on its string content.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the position as the item (placeholder implementation).

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the position as item ID.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses a TextView for list item display, setting text from the string array.
